subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and participate in the test

402300101.text: We made it... Wow, the whole gang's here — even Master Diluc!

402300102.text: Well, Jean wanted my input on everything... Even though I left the Knights, Grand Master Varka has done a lot for me.

402300103.text: He didn't stop me from leaving back then, or throw any administrative roadblocks my way, so I owe him one.

402300104.text: Well, I was sad to see you go, but your mind was made up... And, anyhow, you're an adult. As long as you're prepared to follow through on your choices, who am I to stop you?

402300105.text: Heh, and lemme tell you, my rebellious streak was way worse back in the day... *yawn*

402300106.text: Um, you look pretty tired... Late night yesterday?

402300107.text: Yeah, didn't get much sleep at all, and now my head's killing me... All my terrible memories of being Grand Master came rushing back at once.

402300108.text: The Grand Master's wording is somewhat misleading, so allow me to elaborate.

402300109.text: We made quick work of our tasks yesterday, much to the Grand Master's great pleasure, so he hit up his friend Charles for a few drinks.

402300110.text: Haha, you know how it is. When you're catchin' up with an old friend, a few drinks turn into a few too many, am I right?

402300111.text: Ahh, so you're just hungover! Ugh, and Paimon was starting to feel bad for you!

402300113.text: I just received word from the Knights stationed at the venue that the setup is complete. You can start today's story at any time.

402300118.text: Ah, you mean like how only you could have purified Dvalin's tears...

402300119.text: That ability is unique to you, and to be honest, a lot of people might not even know you're capable of something like that, so they might get stuck at that point in the story.

402300120.text: Don't worry, I thought about that. The story told within the bubble has some jumps. I've deleted the parts that might complicate things.

402300121.text: The remaining content doesn't require the participant to do much of anything, actually. It should be like watching a play, except you get to walk around as you enjoy the performance.

402300122.text: Wait, but we ran into a combat encounter yesterday, when that Fungus jumped out at us...

402300123.text: We'll take care of that. Alice and I want this to be an experience even a child can complete without trouble.

402300124.text: The parts you're testing today are more stable, so there shouldn't be too many bugs.

402300125.text: Of course, when you access the dicier sections, be sure to keep our vision in mind.

402300127.text: Speaking of Alice, where is she?

402300128.text: Klee demanded some playtime with her mom. And, of course, as far as Alice is concerned, nothing is more important than a request from her daughter.

402300130.text: Hahaha, well let's get this show on the road. I'm ready to witness our Honorary Knight's story first-hand!

402300201.text: Whew... So this is where the chase ends this time...

402300202.text: Wait a minute! This isn't what their hideout looked like! It's at least a few times bigger!

402300203.text: Yes, I remember it being much more run-down. This place has far more structural appeal.

402300204.text: The Lawrence Clan lived here for a time, but this doesn't look like their handiwork. And I know for sure it's not the work of the Knights.

402300205.text: Must be a bit of creative license on the part of our dear mages, then.

402300206.text: Alice said the original was too run-down and didn't fit her aesthetic taste.

402300207.text: So we repurposed some assets from the Golden Apple Archipelago. As you can imagine, Alice has always been a "go big or go home" kind of person.

402300209.text: Still, our mission remains the same. We're here to get back the Holy Lyre.

402300210.text: Yeah, and this time we have a whole bunch of people to help us, not just Diluc. Should be a total piece of cake!

402300301.text: Whoa, dizzy... That's gonna take some getting used to. Why didn't that happen the first time?

402300302.text: Ah, looks like we've jumped forward a bit since yesterday... We're at the Favonius Cathedral now.

402300303.text: Wait, is this the bit where we st— Or, um, "borrow" the Holy Lyre?

402300304.text: A—And we're sure we wanna expose this little detail?

402300305.text: Yeah, Paimon's not sure about this... Also, why is Tone-Deaf Bard the only one here? What about Varka and the others?

402300306.text: Hehe, don't worry. I'm sure Nicole has it all planned out.

402300308.text: Word from the Knights of Favonius is that the Fatui are planning to steal the Holy Lyre der Himmel. Unfortunately, that intel came a little late.

402300309.text: A conflict between the two parties is ensuing inside. If the Fatui succeed, we'll miss our chance to borrow the Lyre.

402300310.text: Come on. Let's go help the Knights.

402300314.text: Ohh, so that's how we're explaining this part. Huh, pretty convincing.

402300315.text: Hehe, it's all thanks to that committed performance from our good friend Diluc.

402300316.text: I'm just reading the lines Miss Nicole gave me. You need to play along, okay? The Kameras are rolling.

402300317.text: Don't worry. Our operation isn't that strict. If there are slip-ups, I'll just delete them later. Feel free to take a relaxed approach.

402300318.text: Wait, that was Nicole's voice. Where's it coming from...?

402300320.text: That's right. This is a kind of communication magic — the same one the Knights of Favonius used to get in touch with me earlier.

402300321.text: If you get stuck at any point, you can contact me through this magic, and I'll provide a few hints.

402300322.text: How very convenient. I suppose, given how the story is progressing, we don't have to worry about "borrowing" the Holy Lyre then.

402300323.text: That's right. Obviously, we're not including the stealing part in this version of the story.

402300324.text: After all, the Fatui were the ones who ended up with it. Borrowing, stealing... leaving out that detail doesn't change the direction of the story.

402300325.text: Anyway, the Knights are currently fighting to protect the Holy Lyre. Varka and Jean are already in the underground area. We should head over as well.

402300326.text: Hehe, this is like getting to read the script before watching the movie!

402300327.text: I wonder, what would happen if, this time, we managed to catch the Fatui thief in the act?

402300328.text: That would... complicate things. Worst case scenario, we might need to do another take, so if you could refrain from going off script, that would be great.

402300330.text: Someone's got an axe to grind...

402300401.text: You're just in time. The situation is not looking good at the moment — the Fatui brought much more force than expected.

402300402.text: Yeah, it's turned into quite a mess.

402300403.text: You're not bad, boy. Against the Fatui, though... You'll need to try harder than that.

402300404.text: You ain't messing around, huh? Take this!

402300405.text: Oh no. If this keeps up, the Holy Lyre's gonna be—

402300406.text: Ugh, sorry. Paimon can't do this. Nicole, shouldn't these people be wearing Fatui costumes at least?

402300407.text: Yeah, it's kinda hard to get in the zone when our opponents look like average guild members.

402300408.text: Huh, let me see here... Ah, it looks like magical auto-load has been disabled, so the Fatui costumes didn't appear.

402300409.text: I'll get that fixed... Just ignore the problem for now and continue with the scene. Remember, this is a tense moment.

402300410.text: Got it. In that case... I'll evacuate the members of the Church right away!

402300412.text: #As you see, {NICKNAME}... The situation is dire. We need to retrieve the Holy Lyre and get it back to headquarters.

402300413.text: Looks like the Fatui are tied up fighting the Knights. I doubt they have the manpower to spare to deal with us.

402300414.text: Which means, if we rush in, we should be able to retrieve the Lyre.

402300416.text: You all sure are getting into character... Okay then, let's go!

subQuests.subQuestName: Approach the Holy Lyre der Himmel

402300501.text: The Holy Lyre! There it is!

402300503.text: It seems our outer diversions were most effective. The Knights know not that the true danger lurks right beneath their nose!

402300504.text: It's no wonder you're known as the youngest, most capable Electro Cicin mage in your unit. You can read our enemy like a book.

402300515.text: You heard her! Put it down and put 'em up, or this is gonna get ugly!

402300507.text: ...Wait, why are you the only one with a costume, Fischl?

402300508.text: Why, because I fashioned this headpiece myself, of course! How does it look? I am the spitting image of an Electro Cicin Mage, am I not?

402300509.text: And, I suppose, I look enough like an Electro Cicin as I am.

402300510.text: ...Hold on. Trying to distract me with conniving conversation, are you?

402300511.text: Hah! You underestimate me, to think I would appear before you without full confidence in my victory! Go forth, Oz— Ahem, Cicins. Take care of these pests.

402300512.text: The Holy Lyre der Himmel belongs to the Fatui!

402300513.text: Whoa, that was fast — mage-powered flight is something else!

402300514.text: Fischl is— Or, um, the Fatuus is getting away! After her, quick!

402302201.text: Here, take it away, and don't let them catch you!

402302202.text: Hah! That's nothing the gliding champion of the Fatui can't handle!

subQuests.subQuestName: Track the target to the Fatui hideout

402300601.text: Alright, here's the crest. And with that, I'm off the clock.

402300602.text: Oh, and by the way, word has it you accomplished something major in Nod-Krai. You reeled in the true moon from beyond the false firmament...

402300604.text: Well, I spend most of my time staring into a scryglass, after all. If something changes in the sky, you think I wouldn't notice?

402300605.text: Hydromancy uses the false stars to reflect true fate within the water. Now, I can't help but wonder what I would we see if I cast a reflection of the true moon instead...

402300606.text: Of course, I need a whole new set of equipment to look into that, which means shelling out a whole lot of Mora. So, I've been taking on a lot of odd jobs.

402300607.text: No wonder Alice gave you quite a few parts in this.

402300608.text: Generous compensation, minimal manual labor... It's been a good gig. Plus, the Hexenzirkel never promises an amount they can't deliver...

402300609.text: Even though her daughter is, in some part, responsible for my predicament, that was a long time ago, and I know Klee didn't mean it.

402300610.text: Huh, I guess the moon's a big deal in hydromancy. Just spitballing here, but it kinda sounds like your progress would be much faster if you, I don't know... just contacted Barbeloth directly.

402300611.text: Ugh, c'mon! Enough about that old hag. You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?

subQuests.subQuestName: Track the target to the Fatui hideout

402300701.text: A human never doubts what their eyes see, or rejects the ground beneath their feet.

402300702.text: Both now warn you that this is the end of the road. Give up and turn back while you can.

402300704.text: Mona? Oh, you mean Barbeloth's student.

402300705.text: You know about her? But, Mona came to Mondstadt after your expedition left...

402300706.text: Well, I had regular contact with the Hexenzirkel, so her name came up now and then. The whole thing about her messing up and being too afraid to go back... Yeah, I know that too.

402300708.text: How? No one in the Hexenzirkel should know about that!

402300709.text: For real? Uh, sorry but I'm pretty sure all the mages know...

402300711.text: I'm afraid so... Oh, except Rhinedottir, I suppose.

402300713.text: Fine! That's just... fine. It's not like the old hag's gonna come find me in Mondstadt to settle the score... right?

402300714.text: Uh, anyway... How do we cross?

402300716.text: Aw, c'mon. Don't take it out on us.

402300717.text: I'm not! This is... unrelated! Besides, I'm playing a Fatuus whose job it is to issue riddles. You can't just ask me for the answer!

402300718.text: Oh, right. Almost forgot about that.

402300719.text: If you want the answer, think back to what I said at the beginning.

402300801.text: Gotta say, Paimon didn't expect you to play this kind of role, Durin...

402300802.text: Well, actually, Aunt Alice was planning for me to play Dvalin if the dragon himself didn't agree to take part. That was the backup plan.

402300803.text: Apparently, there's a spell like the one used to make Simulanka, that could change me back into an evil dragon.

402300804.text: That does not sound like a good idea.

402300805.text: I have to agree. That sounds like a disaster waiting to happen.

402300806.text: I don't think I'd be very good at playing the evil dragon, anyway. I'm not intimidating enough...

402300807.text: Luckily, Dvalin agreed to take part after all, so my role was switched to "Timid Fatui Guard B," and I got to wear a costume instead...

402300808.text: Wow, that's a pretty huge change. Why "B" though?

402300810.text: As expected, Alice has got it all planned out.

402300901.text: Looks like Mika's guarding this spot.

402300902.text: Oh, hey! It's been a while!

402300904.text: No, wait. My line— Ahem, How did you get in here?

402300905.text: I would think you have bigger concerns right now. Tell us where to find the Lyre.

402300906.text: ...It's locked in the back room. But, good luck getting in there. Three crests are needed to enter, and each one is guarded by a Fatuus...

402300907.text: Wait but, in real life, we only needed one key...

402300908.text: Yes, but there are three locations to visit. If there was only one key to be found, there's a good chance the encounters set up at the other two locations would go to waste.

402300909.text: All our actors worked so hard to memorize their lines. It would be a shame if their part got skipped over.

402300910.text: Fair point. They're playing through the story just like us, after all.

402300911.text: To be honest, when I first read my lines, I was kinda confused at how I just... give up the intel without a fight.

402300912.text: But when I actually had to stand off against all of you... it made sense.

402300913.text: I mean, Mr. Diluc practically had me in a cold sweat!

402300914.text: Really? I only had one line.

402300915.text: Aha, yet in a game of cards, it's the ones that remain unturned that strike the greatest fear in your opponent. The same principle applies here.

402300916.text: That's right, and I've been told you have quite a few tricks up your sleeve, Mr. Diluc...

402300917.text: Anyway, you can head in now. Everyone should be ready.

402300918.text: One moment, we can't quite end it like this. I believe you have one more line, Mika.

402300919.text: Do... *sigh* D—Do I have to say it?

402300922.text: I—I told you everything I know! Now leave me alone!

subQuests.subQuestName: Explore the area and find the crest

402304001.text: Okay, okay. You win... *sigh* Somehow, this round wasn't quite as fun...

402304002.text: Probably 'cause you had to act like a Fatuus. At this point, I can take down those with my eyes closed haha...

402304003.text: Hahaha, true. Guess I didn't stand a chance, huh...

402304004.text: Oh, so you were the one in the Fatuus costume! Does that mean the auto-load bug is fixed now, Nicole?

402304006.text: Man, their armor is heavy... and not breathable at all. You're telling me the Fatui in Sumeru and Natlan also wear this stuff? I can't even imagine...

402304007.text: Rumor has it Fatui recruits undergo rigorous training. I feel like there's some truth to that after all.

402304010.text: Well, even though we lost, Dad had fun for sure! Here's the crest I was guarding. You've earned it!

402304011.text: Oh, and Bennett told me about what happened in Natlan, how you helped him navigate his past... It's hard to believe we finally have answers after all these years.

402304012.text: So on behalf of all the adventurers in Mondstadt, truly, I can't thank you enough.

402304013.text: Well, that's what friends are for, right?

402304014.text: Speaking of, how have things been since you got back, Bennett?

402304015.text: Same old same old, hahaha. Bad luck included... But, that part's nothing new, so I don't mind.

402304016.text: I do miss the Asha though. I hope I get the chance to show them Mondstadt someday.

subQuests.subQuestName: Explore the area and find the crest
Explore the area and find the crest

402301306.text: Hehehe, I think so too! Come on, let's blow them aaaalll up!

402301307.text: Mom, when can I play with the magic toy you made me?

402301308.text: Very soon, darling. In fact, it should be ready tomorrow! I just know you're going to love it!

402301310.text: Why, of course! We'll have ourselves a splendid time!

402306301.text: The Fatuus up ahead values wealth above all else. No bargaining chip is off the table.

402306302.text: Luckily, I've prepared a negotiation multitool for this situation. Don't forget to take it with you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to Mika to proceed further

402301402.text: Alright. This elevator's a bit complicated to operate, so Miss Nicole asked me to help activate it. Just one moment...

402301404.text: No problem. Best of luck up there.

402301405.text: Huh, I don't remember Fatui being this nice. Where's the fun in that?

402301406.text: Of course you wanna make things difficult... C'mon, let's get out of here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel
Retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel

402301701.text: The Holy Lyre! There it is! Wait, but Paimon remembers something about a—

402301702.text: Haha! Hot-blooded, careless, and reckless heroes... Despair, for you have stepped into my trap!

402301703.text: Wait, what? All it did was lock the lyre up?

402301704.text: You're surprised by your own trap?

402301705.text: Well, I wasn't the one who designed it! All Alice said was that activating it would turn the tables!

402301708.text: (Hmph, they laugh as if they already know what is to transpire... I do not have a good feeling about this.)

402301709.text: Allow me to clarify before we proceed... How was it that the Lyre was retrieved back then?

402301710.text: From what I've heard, the Fatui Agent guarding this place was given a thorough beating, and then the lock opened.

402301711.text: So then... I'm the one who walked into the trap!

402301712.text: Do not despair, Mein Fräulein. Miss Alice provided us with back-up, did she not? We are not entirely out-matched.

402301713.text: ...'Tis true. Though thine Prinzessin stands on the cusp of defeat, courage has not yet failed her! Let this be our last stand!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Electro Cicin Mage

402301901.text: A—A—Alright! I know when I'm beat. You win!

402301902.text: You were brilliant, Miss Fischl. The recording was fantastic — I'm certain future participants will have a great time.

402301903.text: Yeah! This role was perfect for you!

402301904.text: Hmph. Your praise is a compliment to your own good sense, yet know that this is but the least of your Prinzessin's abundant talents.

402301905.text: Huh, it doesn't look like the lock has opened, though...

402301906.text: True. This isn't what we were told would happen.

402301907.text: I doubt the mages want us to just... break it open. It's not their style.

402301908.text: Perhaps we haven't met a certain condition, then?

402301911.text: W—Wait... Does that mean the "beating up" part has to happen for this to proceed? You dare place your Prinzessin in such a scene!? 'Tis an affront of the highest order!

402301912.text: I'm afraid it may be the only way to end this, Mein Fräulein. But not to worry — it's all pretend, after all.

402301913.text: ...Very well. I shall allow this trespass, if only to bring this to an end.

402301916.text: Huh? Oh, right. Paimon's the weakest one here. Here goes nothin'.

402301918.text: *sigh* Miss Alice does love to tease, doesn't she.

402301919.text: Congratulations on obtaining the Holy Lyre der Himmel! That's a wrap for now!

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to Mondstadt and attend the gathering

402302001.text: As the performance within the magic bubble comes to an end, the actors return to the real world one after another.

402302002.text: Varka has the Good Hunter staff set up a banquet in front of the Cathedral, inviting all involved to celebrate.

402302003.text: Wow, this is quite the gathering! Mmm, and do you smell that? Oh, is that the secret menu Varka was talking about?

402302004.text: Looks like we get to try it out, after all.

402302005.text: Paimon's stomach has been rumbling this whole time, so she's gonna dig in. Don't forget to grab some food before it's all gone, okay?

402302007.text: Oh, hello. Did you need something?

402302008.text: Nope. Just noticed that you seem a lot more relaxed.

402302009.text: You know, we often threw banquets like this when I was little.

402302010.text: But then, as more and more of our ranks left on expeditions, and I was left in charge, the number of celebrations decreased. I'm not the most natural entertainer, after all.

402302011.text: Now, seeing a gathering like this after all this time, I can't help but feel a bit... regretful for not keeping up the tradition.

402302016.text: You told me you wanted the expedition members to feel at home.

402302017.text: But, in my eyes, the feeling of home isn't something you can force. Home is... what happens when we're all together like this.

402302018.text: ...You're right. And you know what? I've been coming to the same conclusion.

402302019.text: The location isn't the most important factor. No matter how far we get from Mondstadt, home is wherever we're together.

402302101.text: Have a seat. I come bearing drinks. Booze-free, of course. You're welcome.

402302103.text: Ahhh, well, that's what being home is all about, right? Letting go, feeling at ease... Figure we both deserve that after all this time.

402302105.text: You think so? Heh, glad to hear it.

402302106.text: There's no place like home... That's what people say, right? The expedition took me far and wide, and still, a little alcohol in my system... it would all come back.

402302107.text: The Cathedral, this statue, the windmills in the city, the pigeons and dandelions in front of the gate...

402302108.text: The further away you get, the more you miss it. I might be biased, but... means a lot that you care about this place.

402302111.text: #Still, {M#she}{F#he} is more important to me than any specific place.

402302112.text: I get that. The people are what make Mondstadt what it is, too... all the carefree kids running around, livening up the place.

402302113.text: Which reminds me, I never thanked you for helping Mondstadt out back then.

402302114.text: It takes a special person to do what you did. Most people are helpless in the face of Abyssal corruption. Considering their target was Dvalin... things could have been bad.

402301002.text: What, the more roles you play, the more you get paid. That's what Alice said. I was hoping to do even more than this, but it is what it is... Anyway, ahem...

402301003.text: The crest is with me. All I need to know is... how much you're willing to cough up to get it.

402301101.text: Heh, looks like we were followed. Guess Mondstadt's elite aren't to be underestimated, huh...

402301103.text: But this time, I'm fully locked and loaded! Come on, kid, let's finish what we started!

402301201.text: The Fatuus up ahead values wealth above all else. No bargaining chip is off the table.

402304101.text: What? They handed over their crests?

402304102.text: ...Looks like the decision has been made for me, then. Further resistance would be foolish.

402304201.text: Coming here first? Hm, I'd reconsider if I were you.

402304202.text: You've been warned. Continue at your own risk.

402304301.text: Hah! Not a chance. If that's your offer, might as well call it here.

402304401.text: Hmm... No. We both know this crest is worth more than that.

402304501.text: Good enough for me. Gotta know when to fold, right?

402304601.text: Hehehe, who would've thought there was this much Mora to be made in a dump like Mondstadt...

402304602.text: Hey, did you just break character?

402304801.text: Heh, that's all? You have to at least make it worth my while.

402305101.text: Talk about bad luck... The minute you put on that Fatui costume, the gun stopped working. Hahaha... How weird is that?

402305102.text: Heh, yeah. Thanks for stepping in, Dad. Guess I'll have to hand it in to Miss Nicole for repairs later...

402305201.text: Ugh, c'mon! Enough about that old hag. You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?

402305301.text: I'm just glad I didn't have to play the evil dragon in the end...

402305401.text: Without the crests, I can't activate this device either... Like I said, I told you everything I know. Just leave me alone.

402305402.text: Man, I thought I lucked out with just a few lines, but it still wasn't easy to pull off.

402305403.text: Anyway, if you want to get into that room, you'll need to track down the three Fatui with the crests.

402305501.text: I doubt you need a hint for this area. Go on now — the underground chamber awaits!

402305601.text: What a coincidence... Or perhaps I should say, great minds think alike.

402305602.text: Yes, well... This looked like the most relaxed part of the performance.

402305603.text: I'd prefer to get this over with and return to my work as soon as possible. I'm assuming you feel the same, Miss Lisa?

402305604.text: Of course. After all, this place suffers from a dire lack of comfortable chairs and good tea.

402305701.text: *panting* I couldn't keep up with you after all, Grand Master... It's like you've gotten even stronger since I last saw you.

402305702.text: Expeditions have a way of doing that to people. Ever consider taking your adventurers out on a long trip?

402305801.text: I never thought I'd get the chance to spar with the Cavalry Captain...

402305802.text: Hehe, I'm always up for a duel, as long as you treat me to a glass of wine after we're done.

402306001.text: If the conflict really had escalated to this point back then... *sigh* Just imagine the cleanup work.

402306002.text: Yeah, good thing it didn't turn out like that. No use thinking about something that didn't happen, right?

402306003.text: ...When your free time is as precious as mine, it's hard not to think about it.

402306101.text: Mona's riddle was as follows: "A human never doubts what their eyes see, or rejects the ground beneath their feet."

402306102.text: However, things that are taken to be indisputable are often false. So, one must shift one's gaze elsewhere. Perhaps... upward.

402306201.text: The Fatuus up ahead is courageous and loyal. Be prepared for a head-on clash.

402306401.text: The Fatuus up ahead is a pragmatist. You might have a chance to avoid conflict if you obtain the other crests first.

402306501.text: Wanna eat at our table? A whole bunch of friends are there!

402308301.text: Don't worry! Paimon'll save you a serving of every delicious dish!

402308401.text: Noelle! I've been looking everywhere for you. Come on, join us!

402308402.text: Just give me one second. I need to bring a few crates of drinks over first. But I'll be done soon, I promise!

402308403.text: Haha, in that case, I'll help you out!

402308501.text: ...As the battle hung in the balance, I spoke an incantation from the Immernachtreich, broke through their ranks with ease, and thus the Holy Lyre was mine! Hmph, 'twas light work for one such as I.

402308502.text: Cyrus told me all about it. You were amazing!

402308503.text: Having seen it for myself, I must admit... You were quite something, my lady. Why, I bet even Barbatos himself would have been hard pressed to catch up with you!

402308504.text: (That was Hexenzirkel magic not some incantation, but... Whatever. Guess I'll let her have her moment...)

402308601.text: Even though I didn't have a lot of lines, I still had fun. It... kind of felt like being back in Simulanka.

402308602.text: Acting out a light-hearted script alongside a bunch of friends... It was nice to have a laid-back experience for once.

402308603.text: Quite a change of pace from our experience in Nod-Krai, huh.

402308604.text: Yeah, this was far less complicated.

402308605.text: Haha, you can say that again.

402309903.text: The road ahead is almost completely blocked. Looks like this person isn't taking visitors.

402309904.text: Guess we'll just have to be careful. We need that crest.

402309905.text: Alright, we got all the crests. Let's head back and look for Mika.
